title: [3.0 beta4] can't change TBR -Dash
symptom: User reports cannot change TBR via NSclient, receiving message 'Data from another pump. Change pump driver, to reset pump state.' Also TBR not synchronizing to NSClient, and issue appears related to T:0,00 U/h.
fix: Maintainer MilosKozak states 'you cannot set TBR from NSClient. with any version' and later says 'i improved TBR sync in commit e14fc44957e2339d2c63726d548f144b0dd766e2'.
